_note: Armored Core VI clip(s) -> Elden Ring clip ids that play in the same game state. ac6 lists clips played one after the other. Every ported clip is time-fitted to the Elden Ring clip it replaces, so the Elden Ring state machine's timing and TAE events stay aligned. Identity ports (same a000_ id in both games) are done for every common id not listed here.

mappings.name: blade slash (L1): AC6 left-arm laser blade attack stance; replaces the 5 hits of the game's L1 combo; no root motion, the mod does the lunge
quick boost / dodge (AC6 quick boost dip; keeps AC6 length, the mod's burst lasts about that long)
fall / hover loop (AC6 crouched boost stance)
